Class ArgParams

java.lang.Object
threepl.nodes.ArgParams
public class ArgParams extends Object
A class containing the operand widths and offsets, the result type, width and offset and the operand TDEVars which might have been left-shifted to align them.

  • Constructor Details

    • ArgParams

      public ArgParams(RefOrVal l, Val r, Constant.TreeOp op, TDEConstants.TDEOp top, boolean use_left, SrcLoc loc)
      Determine the result type, width and offset of an operation and align operands where necessary.
      Parameters:
      l - is the left operand
      r - is the right operand
      op - is the tree operator
      top - is the associated TDE operator
      use_left - if true indicates that in all cases except multiplication and division the right operand offset should be adjusted to match the left operand regardless of relative offsets
      loc - is the source file location
